newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- South African deputy foreign minister to arrive in Riyadh on April 30.
- A three-member Indian parliamentary team will visit Saudi Arabia to suggest relief measures for Indian victims of the fire in Mena on April 15 in which 343 pilgrims died.
- There are around 580 million riyals worth of investment opportunities in industrial mineral projects in Saudi Arabia, petroleum and mineral resources ministry says.
- At least 20 Bangladeshi pilgrims died of natural causes during this year's haj, which ended last week.
- Saudi commerce minister leaves for Malaysia for talks aimed at boosting economic and trade relations between the two Moslem countries.
